Surfhouse Residences

Condominium in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Bang Tao / Laguna
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleSurfhouse Residences

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Surfhouse Residences is a boutique seven-storey condominium of 34 residences in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, developed and managed by SALA Hospitality Group. Units range from one to three bedrooms. Facilities include an 18-metre saltwater pool, gym, lobby lounge and concierge service.

Surfhouse Residences: key facts

  • Surfhouse Residences is a boutique low-rise condominium in Cherngtalay, Phuket, developed by SALA Hospitality Group.
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 60.26–171.87 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Jan 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿8,400,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Laguna Golf Phuket (1.6 km); Padel Bay Indoor Club (1.3 km); SAii Laguna Phuket (3.3 km); Thalang Hospital (3.1 km).

Facilities & amenities

  • 18 m saltwater swimming pool
  • Gym / fitness centre
  • Laundry room
  • Lobby social area
  • Covered parking
  • 24/7 security and CCTV
  • 24/7 concierge
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Pet-friendly
  • Rental management and housekeeping by SALA
